
---
title: "Titanic Dashboard"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)

df <- read_csv("https://bryantstats.github.io/math421/data/titanic_final.csv") |>
  drop_na(Age, Embarked) |>
  mutate(
    date = mdy(date),
    Survived = factor(Survived, levels = c(0, 1),
                      labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Pclass = factor(Pclass),
    AgeGroup = cut(
      Age,
      breaks = c(0, 16, 45, 99, Inf),
      labels = c("0-16", "16-45", "45-99", "100+"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )

empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |>
    layout(title = "No passengers match these inputs.")
}
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

Explore survival rates and age distributions among Titanic passengers.

```{r}
selectInput(
  "var",
  "Choose a variable",
  choices = c("Sex", "Pclass", "Embarked", "AgeGroup")
)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Age by the chosen variable
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Survival by the chosen variable
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Titanic Passenger Data
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

filtered <- reactive({
  df
})

output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())

  p <- ggplot(
    filtered(),
    aes(x = Age, color = .data[[input$var]])
  ) +
    geom_density(na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(
      x = "Age",
      y = "Density",
      color = input$var
    )

  ggplotly(p)
})

output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())

  p <- ggplot(
    filtered(),
    aes(x = .data[[input$var]], fill = Survived)
  ) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill") +
    labs(
      x = input$var,
      y = "Proportion",
      fill = "Survived"
    )

  ggplotly(p)
})

output$tbl <- renderDT({
  filtered() |>
    select(date, Name, Sex, Age, AgeGroup,
           Pclass, Embarked, Survived) |>
    datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
})
```
